title: Youki ni Naritai Shigure-san
titleNative: 陽キになりたい時雨さん
synopsis: In modern times, it seems like the world only has need for extroverts. They're fun, sociable, thoughtful, and basically top-tier humans. But Yoshida isn't like that... So what if he's a hopeless introvert? So what if he always sits alone in the corner of the classroom? Enter Shigure, a classmate who is in the same boat. She boldly declares she's going to become an extrovert, and she challenges Yoshida to do the same...!? Watch as these two high school students try to make the most of their youth, while they still can!

title: Code Geass: Soubou no Oz
titleNative: コードギアス　双貌のオズ
synopsis: Code Geass: Oz the Reflection is a spinoff published in Hobby Japan magazine and Kadokawa Shoten's Newtype Ace magazine. It tells a story from the viewpoints of two different protagonists. The story takes place between the first and second seasons of the TV anime and is told from two perspectives. The photo story in Hobby Japan centers around Orpheus Zevon (Jivon), a young terrorist with the Knightmare Frame (KMF) Byakuen who is in pursuit of his lover's killer. The manga in Newtype Ace revolves around Oldrin Zevon, a girl in the Britannia Empire's anti-terrorist unit Glinda Knights who pilots the KMF Lancelot Grail. (Source: Code Geass Wiki)

titleNative: ふしぎねこのきゅーちゃん
synopsis: An adorable full-color manga series about a young man who rescues a very special cat. There’s more to this kitty than meets the eye! Kyuu-chan loves snacks, cuddles, and bow ties, but above all, this mischievous wondercat loves Hinata, the young professional who adopted Kyuu-chan into his home. As the two adjust to life together, they discover that they have a lot to learn from each other. The ordinary and the extraordinary live side by side in this delightful slice-of-life comic for animal lovers and beyond! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment) Note: Each volume contains a set of bonus pages; each set is considered a chapter.

synonyms: ジャンボマックス ～ハイパーED薬密造人～
synopsis: Tateo Sone runs a pharmacy in Odawara and leads an ordinary but happy life with his beautiful wife and daughter-in-law. One day, however, when his wife tells him she is pregnant, he is shocked. It's because he has a secret: he has never had a functioning lower half of his body. His wife's child is not his own...Tateo despairs at the thought. At that time, a man named Sumaoka happens to give him a mysterious ED drug. Tateo impulsively takes the drug and is shocked to find that the function of his lower body miraculously recovers. Tateo declares to Sumaoka that he will recreate and make this medicine himself. But this is the beginning of a dangerous day that will change his life forever! (Source: Big Comic, translated)

After a night of drinking and wondering if he could change the past, he wakes up the next morning, 20 years younger at the beginning of his career. But he does not yet know how changing the past will affect his future... (Source: WEBTOON)

title: Reincarnated as a Neglected Noble: Raising My Baby Brother With Memories From My Past Life
titleRomaji: Shirobuta Kizoku desu ga Zense no Kioku ga Haeta node Hiyoko na Otouto Sodatemasu @COMIC
titleEnglish: Reincarnated as a Neglected Noble: Raising My Baby Brother With Memories From My Past Life
titleNative: 白豚貴族ですが前世の記憶が生えたのでひよこな弟育てます@COMIC
synopsis: An empire falling to ruin: The Kio Empire. Living in that empire, is an overweight 5-year-old abandoned by his parents, Prince Ageha. Ageha has memories from a previous life of him living as a Japanese man in another world. He then encounters his younger half-brother, Regulus. Ageha had a vision that Regulus will kill him in the future over inheritance, so Ageha sets out to raise him after Regulus's mother passed. Once the sparkling and fluffy-haired Regulus cozied up to Ageha, He turned into a doting older brother before he even realized! Enjoy a fantasy story of young brothers managing their kingdom, sometimes involving the gods, as they reform it step by step to bring a better land to the next generation! (Source: MangaPlaza)
